normalIntro.en: Willpower is two everyday words pressed together: the will that chooses plus the power that makes the choice stick.
normalIntro.cn: willpower 是两个常用词拼在一起：负责选择的 will 加上让选择生效的 power。

normal.en: Will is the old English word for choosing, and power is strength, so willpower is strength of choice.
normal.cn: will 是古英语中「选择」的词，power 是力量，所以 willpower 就是选择之力。

normal.en: Willpower is often uncountable: we say a lot of willpower, not many willpowers.
normal.cn: willpower 通常不可数：说「很大的意志力」，而不用复数。

normal.en: Willful and willingness share the same will, though their tones differ.
normal.cn: willful 与 willingness 共享同一个 will，只是语感不同。

normal.en: A lack of willpower is a common excuse for broken habits.
normal.cn: lack of willpower（缺乏意志力）是坏习惯没改掉时常见的借口。

normal.en: Compare grit: grit is steady endurance, willpower is the force that stops you slipping now.
normal.cn: 对比 grit：grit 强调长期的耐力，willpower 强调此刻不松手的力量。

abstract.en: Picture a tired hand still holding the switch so the light stays on.
abstract.cn: 想象一只疲惫的手仍紧按开关，让灯一直亮着。

abstract.en: Imagine a runner who does one more lap although every part says stop.
abstract.cn: 想象一名跑者明明全身都在喊停，却又多跑了一圈。

abstract.en: Think of a battery bar that shrinks as the day goes on.
abstract.cn: 想象一根电量条随着一天过去而逐渐缩短。

examples.en: Quitting coffee required more willpower than she expected.
examples.cn: 戒掉咖啡所需的意志力超出她的预料。

examples.en: Coaches say that willpower matters as much as talent.
examples.cn: 教练们说意志力与天赋同样重要。

examples.en: He relied on pure stubborn willpower to finish the marathon.
examples.cn: 他全靠一股固执的意志力跑完了马拉松。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威尔炮」——心底有一股像大炮一样的劲，推着自己不放弃；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 willa（意志、选择）+ 古法语 poeir（力量，源出拉丁语 posse 能够）→ 合成词 willpower，核心义「选择之力」。

sensesIntro.en: Willpower begins as the force of self control, extends to persistence over time, and is finally treated as a limited resource that runs down.
sensesIntro.cn: willpower 先指自我控制的力量，再指随时间推移的坚持力，最后被当作会逐渐耗尽的有限资源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tired hand still holding the switch so that the light stays on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只疲惫的手仍紧按开关，让灯保持亮着。

branches.en: The power of the will over oneself is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 意志对自身的力量是基本义项。

branches.en: Holding on in time gives the persistence sense.
branches.cn: 在时间中持续用力，生出坚持义项。

branches.en: Treating that force as spendable gives the resource sense.
branches.cn: 把这种力量看作可消耗的，就得到资源义项。

branches.en: Resisting temptation uses up the same supply that is measured in studies.
branches.cn: 抵抗诱惑所动用的，正是研究中被测量的那部分供应。

branches.en: Long tasks keep pulling on a store that is already low.
branches.cn: 漫长的任务不断消耗本已不多的储备。

intro.en: Willpower is a native compound: the Germanic will meets the Romance power, and English keeps building on both halves.
intro.cn: willpower 是英语本族合成词：日耳曼来源的 will 遇上罗曼语来源的 power，英语在这两半上继续构词。

latinIntro.en: The power half goes back to Latin posse, to be able, through Old French poeir; the will half is Germanic and has no Latin source.
latinIntro.cn: power 这一半经由古法语 poeir 追溯到拉丁语 posse（能够）；will 属于日耳曼语来源，没有拉丁语源头。

items.example: Will is the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: will 是合成词的前半部分。

items.example: Power is the second half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: power 是合成词的后半部分。

items.example: Posse lies behind the word power.
items.exampleCN: power 一词可追溯至 posse。

items.example: The suffix -ful forms willful.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ful 构成 willful。

items.example: Willful describes a strong but unruly will.
items.exampleCN: willful 形容强大却不受约束的意志。

definition_zh: 防风林；防风物；挡风的树篱或屏障
definition_en: a row of trees, a fence, or another barrier that stops the wind from reaching a place
core_image: 一排树木横在田边，把风挡在自己身前
scene: 北边的地头上立着一排杨树，风到这里就慢了下来。A line of poplars acts as a windbreak for the young apple trees.
sceneCN: 这里 windbreak 是「防风林」（第 1 个义项：阻挡强风的成排树木或屏障）；句意：一排杨树为幼小的苹果树挡住了风。

wind 加 -blown 构成，义为「被风吹乱的」

senses.title: A barrier of trees or fences
senses.definition: a row of trees or other solid barrier planted to protect land from the wind
senses.definitionCN: 为保护土地免受风吹而种植的一排树或其他坚固屏障
senses.example: The farmer planted a windbreak along the north edge of the field.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫在田地的北缘种了一排防风林。
senses.why: Break means to stop, so a windbreak is literally a thing that breaks the rush of wind; the row of trees is the common form it takes.
senses.whyCN: break 意为阻挡，所以 windbreak 字面就是「打断风势的东西」；成排的树木是它最常见的形式。

senses.title: Shelter in the open
senses.definition: a natural or built shelter that gives people or animals protection from the wind
senses.definitionCN: 为人或动物提供挡风庇护的自然或人工遮蔽物
senses.example: The hikers rested in the windbreak of a low stone wall.
senses.exampleCN: 徒步者在一堵矮石墙的背风处休息。
senses.why: Because the barrier stops the wind, the calm space behind it is also called the windbreak, and the word moves from the thing to the shelter it gives.
senses.whyCN: 屏障挡住风，它背后的平静空间也被叫作 windbreak，词义于是从「物」转到「物所提供的庇护」。

senses.title: Shelter belt in forestry
senses.definition: a planned belt of trees planted across farmland or along a road to cut wind damage
senses.definitionCN: 有计划地横跨农田或沿道路种植、以减少风害的树带
senses.example: Shelter belts and windbreaks reduce soil erosion across the plains.
senses.exampleCN: 防护林带和防风林减少了平原上的水土流失。
senses.why: Planted in long belts and measured in hectares, the simple barrier becomes a unit of land management with its own name in forestry.
senses.whyCN: 当它以长条带的形式大规模种植并以面积衡量时，这种简单的屏障就成了林业中具有专门名称的土地管理单位。

intro.en: Windbreak is an English compound of the native noun wind and the verb break, put together to name something that blocks the wind.
intro.cn: windbreak 是英语复合词，由本族词 wind（风）与 break（打断、阻挡）合成，用来指挡住风的东西。

items.en: Wind names the moving air, from a Germanic root.
items.cn: 古英语 wind 指流动的空气，源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: Brecan means to break or shatter.
items.cn: 古英语 brecan 意为打断、击碎。

items.en: Colonists plant rows of trees as windbreaks on open farmland.
items.cn: 大约十八世纪，移民在开阔农田上栽种成排树木作为防风林。

items.en: The compound widens to fences, walls and other sheltering objects.
items.cn: 该复合词扩展到栅栏、墙和其他遮蔽物。

items.en: Windbreak also names clothing such as the windbreaker jacket.
items.cn: 现代英语中，windbreak 也指防风衣一类的衣物。

items.en: Forestry studies windbreaks as shelter belts against soil erosion.
items.cn: 林业把防风林作为防治水土流失的防护林带加以研究。

note.en: Windbreak is a transparent compound with break, so it sits beside words such as breakwater and windbreaker in form, and beside shelter and screen in meaning.
note.cn: windbreak 是以 break 构成的透明复合词，形式上与 breakwater、windbreaker 相邻，意义上与 shelter、screen 相近。

normalIntro.en: Windbreak puts two plain words together: wind is the air, break is the stopping, so the word names the break that the wind runs into.
normalIntro.cn: windbreak 把两个朴素单词拼在一起：wind 是风，break 是阻挡，所以这个词指风撞上的那道「断点」。

normal.en: Break in this compound means to stop, as in breakwater and heartbeat.
normal.cn: 这里的 break 意为阻挡，如同 breakwater（防波堤）中的用法。

normal.en: A windbreak is usually a line of trees on the windy side of a field.
normal.cn: 防风林通常是种在田地迎风侧的一排树。

normal.en: Windbreaker keeps the same shape but names a jacket.
normal.cn: windbreaker 结构相同，但指的是防风夹克。

normal.en: Farm word families pair it with shelterbelt and soil erosion.
normal.cn: 农业语境中，它常与防护林带、水土流失等词一起出现。

normal.en: Compare hedge: a hedge fences a field, a windbreak blocks the wind.
normal.cn: 对比 hedge：树篱围地界，防风林挡风。

abstract.en: Picture a row of trees leaning hard while the grass behind them stays still.
abstract.cn: 想象一排树被风吹得倾斜，而树后的草却纹丝不动。

abstract.en: Imagine putting a hand up against a strong fan to feel the rush stop.
abstract.cn: 想象抬手挡住强风，感到气流突然停住。

abstract.en: Think of a belt of green patrolling the flat farmland.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绿色林带围绕平坦的农田。

examples.en: A windbreak of tall pines protects the vegetable garden in winter.
examples.cn: 一排高大的松树为菜园挡住了冬天的风。

examples.en: Farmers know that windbreaks reduce soil erosion.
examples.cn: 农民知道防风林能减少水土流失。

examples.en: They camped in the lee of a windbreak made from old pallets.
examples.cn: 他们在用旧托盘搭成的避风处背风扎营。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「稳的布雷克」——一排树稳稳地挡在风前，风到了这里就「布」不开了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 本族词 wind（风，日耳曼语来源）+ 古英语 brecan（打断、阻挡）→ windbreak，核心义「把风截断的屏障」。

sensesIntro.en: Windbreak starts with the planted barrier, then moves to the calm place behind any barrier, and finally to the managed shelter belt of forestry.
sensesIntro.cn: windbreak 先指人工栽种的屏障，再指任何屏障背后的避风处，最后指林业中成规模经营的防护林带。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of trees standing across the field edge, taking the wind in front of them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排树横在田边，把风挡在自己身前。

branches.en: The physical barrier is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 实体屏障是基本义项。

branches.en: The calm place behind a barrier is the shelter sense.
branches.cn: 屏障后面的平静处是避风义项。

branches.en: Large planted lines become the forestry sense.
branches.cn: 大规模栽植的树带成为林业义项。

branches.en: A garden row and a forestry belt differ mainly in scale and planning.
branches.cn: 园边的一排树与林业林带主要差别在于规模与规划。

branches.en: A long belt creates a wide zone of calm for crops.
branches.cn: 长条林带为庄稼造出大片平静的风影区。

intro.en: Windbreak is built from two English roots, wind and break, and English uses both halves in many other compounds.
intro.cn: windbreak 由 wind 与 break 两个英语词根构成，这两个成分在英语中还组合出许多其他复合词。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are Germanic and have no Latin ancestor, so this word has no Latin cognates to list.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都属日耳曼语来源，没有拉丁语祖先，因此该词没有可列出的拉丁同源词。
